title: Member Services Desk Reference — Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) Exit, Final Bill and Tier Change Terms
content:
# Exit, Final Bill and Tier Change Terms

Member services desk reference for Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): when a member's confirmed exit takes effect, whether the deferred balance is settled in full on the exit bill, how long after a voluntary exit the same account must wait to enroll again, whether the deferred balance is settled on the final bill when service ends, and whether the member may switch to another plan of the program without leaving it.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Exit takes effect | Deferred balance settled in full on the exit bill | Wait after a voluntary exit before the same account may enroll again | Deferred balance settled on the final bill when service ends | Member may switch to another Budget Billing plan without leaving the program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | next bill | No (rolling: nothing further is spread and the balance is billed on the exit bill as well) | 3 months | Yes | Yes |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | next bill | Yes | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | next bill | Yes | 12 months | Yes | Yes |
| Farm Budget Billing | next bill | Yes | 12 months | Yes | No |
| Small Business Budget Billing | next bill | Yes | 12 months | Yes | No |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | next bill | Yes | 12 months | Yes | No |

## Terms in brief

- **Effective point.** On every plan the plan ends on the next bill after the member's confirmed exit.
- **Exit bill.** On five plans the deferred balance is settled in full on the exit bill. Levelized Billing Rolling Average is a rolling plan: nothing further is spread, and its deferred balance is billed on the exit bill as well.
- **Re-enrollment wait after a voluntary exit.** 3 months on Levelized Billing Rolling Average and 12 months on every other plan, for the same account.
- **Final bill.** On every plan the deferred balance is settled on the final bill when service ends.
- **Switching plans.** Levelized Billing Rolling Average, Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up and Budget Billing Quarterly Review allow the member to switch to another Budget Billing plan without leaving the program. Farm Budget Billing, Small Business Budget Billing and the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan do not.

## Hypothetical readings

- *Hypothetical:* an account that voluntarily left Levelized Billing Rolling Average shows a 3-month wait in its row; one that left Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up shows 12 months.
- *Hypothetical:* a member on Farm Budget Billing reads No in the switching column; a member on Budget Billing Quarterly Review reads Yes.
